subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt moved by Glabbagool's stillness and believed it signaled that Glabbagool had done something worth doing.
source_quote: I thought: that's the face of someone who did a thing worth doing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin considered Glabbagool’s lack of fixed appendages made him tactically unpredictable and potentially dangerous.
source_quote: But he's unpredictable, because there are no fixed appendages.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thought that Glabbagool being equipped as a weapon was wrong because weapons don’t have agency.
source_quote: It's not a weapon. Weapons don't have agency.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believed Dawnbringer had agency, and acknowledged that he himself was also annoying.
source_quote: Weapons don't have agency. Except mine. I'm annoying also, Dawnbringer.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knew Eldeth’s departure was coming and had accepted it intellectually before she spoke.
source_quote: I'd known it was coming.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt he didn’t fit in dwarven society because he was too giant-raised for dwarven spaces and too dwarven for the hills.
source_quote: I had spent most of my life not being the right kind of dwarf for any given room. Too giant-raised for dwarven spaces, too dwarven for the hills.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wanted to petition to become part of Eldeth’s clan and asked if there was a hazing ritual.
source_quote: Is there any way that I can petition to become part of your clan? A pledge, perhaps? Is there a hazing ritual involved?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt a sense of relief and rightness when Eldeth swore she would bring him into her clan after reporting to the lords.
source_quote: Something settled in me at that. The kind of settling that happens when a thing you've been carrying turns out to have been lighter than you thought, or heavier, or just — right.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wanted to learn about his dwarven roots and become an integrated person who honored both his giant upbringing and his cultural heritage.
source_quote: I do want to learn about my dwarven roots. I want to become an integrated person — both my giant upbringing, but also my cultural roots, so, you know.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believed Eldeth’s promise was sincere and not just social nicety.
source_quote: I don't think you're just being socially nice here. I think you really do want me to.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin resented that he had chosen Tremor Sense for underground travel, and now that they were above ground, it was useless.
source_quote: I picked it because we were gonna be fucking underground all the time... And then the one time I need it. We're not underground, and we're not surrounded by fucking stone.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir still scanned his surroundings compulsively after emerging from the Underdark, because his habits hadn't adjusted to open space.
source_quote: The third day of open sky and I still hadn't stopped scanning.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir found the surface world disorienting because it was too loud with information he couldn’t properly interpret.
source_quote: I had too much information and not enough of the right kind. It was disorienting in a way I didn't have language for.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed the northern treeline was wrong because of unnatural stillness — no birds, no wind movement in undergrowth.
source_quote: The trees north of us were wrong. Not visibly wrong. The wrongness was in the negative space — the way no birds had moved through that section for some time, the way the undergrowth hadn't shifted with the wind in quite the pattern it should.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized the thing following them was not a deer, despite Grygum’s conclusion.
source_quote: The three of us looked at each other in the way that the Ember Vanguard has developed as a private language: no words, just a shared acknowledgment that the thing in the trees is not a deer.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recognized the follower was patient and skilled, pacing them rather than trailing, indicating deliberate intent.
source_quote: Whatever was in those trees had been moving with us, shifting position laterally to stay in the blind spots, using the terrain the way someone uses it when they know what they're doing. Not panicked. Not rushing. Patient. The kind of following that isn't trailing — it's pacing.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir understood dusk was the worst possible time for the follower to strike — too dark for detail, too bright for shadow work.
source_quote: Dusk came in from the west... which meant we'd reached the worst possible window: too dark for fine detail, too bright for shadow work.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled that goblin equality and inclusion on the surface was currently poor.
source_quote: The state of goblin equality and inclusion is rough at the moment.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait believed goblins were fully integrated into surface society and that he could safely explore alone.
source_quote: I'm just gonna go explore. It's totally safe for goblins, right? Nobody's gonna attack a goblin for being a goblin. We're totally integrated into the society.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait decided to follow Thorin and the group because he felt safer with them than alone.
source_quote: Do you mind if I just sort of hang out with you guys? Maybe find a nice place?

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool was witnessing the sun with a stillness that was not his usual passive state.
source_quote: Glabbagool just looked up... and there was something in the stillness of him that wasn't his usual stillness. He wasn't being a floor. He was witnessing.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer radiated warmth like a hearth, not directed at any one person but present for all.
source_quote: It radiated warmth the way a hearth does — not directed at anything in particular, just present.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed Dawnbringer warmed slightly when he said they understood each other.
source_quote: The hilt warmed slightly.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized he had forgotten how to interpret environmental silence after months underground.
source_quote: I remember thinking I could be training instead. I don't remember what he said.

subject: Eldeth's promise
fact: Eldeth swore she would make it a statement of purpose that Thorin be embraced by her clan after reporting to the lords.
source_quote: I swear.
